entries.why: pattern selection singleton getter: same shape (alloc, ctor, cached pointer); the ctor 0xC00726C0 twins the Sampler's 0xC008179C (struct 0x34C instead of 0x350, +0x308 field loop equal); the main screen's VALUE and MENU handlers call it right before reading +0x341 in both builds (0xC005B5E4, 0xC005B614)
tail call of the main screen's VALUE handler into the selector (pop {r4,r5,r6,lr}; b selector), after the same wheel-step times ten code (mul r1,r4,#10) as 0xC00650F8..0xC006513C in the Sampler

the selector: the synth inlined the wrap (ldr 0x318; adds; addmi #0xfa; cmp #0xf9; subgt #0xfa) and tail calls set_number 0xC0072948 with r2=1; the only branch to it is the wheel hook site above. Arguments as in the Sampler: r0 = psel, r1 = steps. The synth has no wrap function, the patch carries its own
pad selection: push {r4,lr}; mov r4,r1; bl psel; mov r1,r4; mov r2,#1; pop {r4,lr}; b set_number stub (0xC0072A84 = the Sampler's 0xC008209C), instruction for instruction
second instruction of the pad selection, where the hook continues
MIDI program change handler: push {r3,r4,r5,lr}; mov r5,r1; mov r4,r2; bl psel; ...; b the set_number copy without MIDI (0xC0072858, the Sampler's 0xC0081E60), instruction for instruction
second instruction of the program change handler, where the hook continues

MENU handler of the main screen: push {r4,lr}; psel; ldrb 0x341; cmp; popne. It is slot 6 of the class table at 0xC00C9C30 (value read there). The Sampler's also has a transport state check (0xB) that the synth's lacks; the patch does not depend on it

the call that fetches the number to start at the sequence end: bl PLAYER; mov r4,r0; bl psel; bl getter; mov r2,#0; mov r1,r0; mov r0,r4; bl change (0xC006C434, the Sampler's 0xC0079AA8), then PLAYER +0x320 test, all equal in shape
the number fetch: ldr r0,[r0,#0x318]; bx lr, same two instructions

the load of the NEXT: pointer in the lower line builder. The builder's entry differs (synth push {r0-r6,lr}, Sampler push {r4,r5,lr}; sub sp), the body is the same: ldr r1 pool; mov r5,#1; add r2,sp,#0xc; strb r5,[r0,#0x5c]; strb r5,[r0,#0x14]; mov r4,r0; add r0,sp,#4; bl; bl psel; bl getter; mov r3,r5; mov r2,#3; add r1,r0,r5. r0 must survive, r1 is loaded, r2 and r3 are set after, in both
the string NEXT: in the text pool, between ScaleMode: and MFX:%s in both builds; the literal pool word of the load above (0xC0076F60) holds this address

the transport singleton pointer: the literal pool word of the synth's transport getter 0xC002DBC8 (the Sampler's 0xC0030D28 loads 0xC03405BC), the same getter shape; set_number reads +0x308 of its result in both

the pattern bank in RAM: booted synth in the emulator, scan for the pattern signature PTST gives 250 blocks at a 0x4000 stride from 0xC0783D00 (plus the two live copies), block layout as the Sampler's (name at +0x14, tempo at +38, length byte at +41, the chain fields at 0x3B00 are read by the UI code at 0xC007D88C and 0xC007E43C like the Sampler's 0xC008F30C and 0xC008FC30)
the bank's global block copy (GLST) 0x10000 before the pattern bank in both builds; found by the same scan of the booted synth
the live global block (GLST), found by the same scan of the booted synth; the distance to the bank's copy (0x1FFEAC) equals the Sampler's

the stopped sync of the pattern selection (stopped, chosen not running: load the chosen one): the same 18 instructions as the Sampler's, calling the twins of the transport getter 0xC002DBC8 and the player getter 0xC002C9E8, offsets 0x308, 0x318, 0x340 equal; it sits 0x138 before set_number in both builds
the second instruction of that function (the hook's way back)

pad handler 0xC0044874 found once in the synth at 0xC003EB60 (12 words equal with branch offsets masked: push {r0-r2,r4-r11,lr}, the four movs, bl to the busy getter 0xC002A798, cmp, beq, cmp r4, bne)
the pad handler's bl to the busy getter, +0x14 of the handler in both builds
the pad handler goes on with the pad: the beq target after the busy check, +0x28 in both builds
the pad handler's way out: the bne target of the busy check in both builds (bne +0xfc)
the command runner clears its busy byte (strb r3, [r6, #0x10]): the 8 words 0xC002D810 to 0xC002D82C found once in the synth at 0xC002A974, branch offsets masked
pointer to the command runner, its busy byte at +0x10: the busy getter 0xC002A798 (synth's twin of 0xC002D634) loads it from its literal
